#!/bin/zsh
/bin/mkdir '<DIR>/started' 2>/dev/null || exit 0
/bin/rm -f '<DIR>/continue.command'
trap '/bin/rm -rf '\''<DIR>'\''' EXIT
cd '<CWD>' && TMPDIR='/tmp/x y' BUDDY_TASK_ID='tsk_0123456789ab' /bin/echo --resume 11111111-2222-4333-8444-555555555555 --settings /Users/fixture/run/settings.json 'it'\''s $HOME' ''
result=$?
print "Plexiform terminal session ended. Return to Tasks to hand it back."
exit $result
